create_graph_with_nodes_and_arcs: create a GTN graph by adding start/accept nodes and arcs with labels and weights
test_graph_weight_operations: test getting and setting graph arc weights as lists, numpy arrays, or raw pointers
compare_graphs_for_equality_and_isomorph: compare two GTN graphs for exact equality or structural isomorphism using gtn.equal and gtn.isomorphic
save_and_load_graphs: save a GTN graph to disk in text or binary format and load it back for verification
run_autograd_backward_pass: run backward pass on GTN graph operations to compute gradients with optional retain graph and input deltas
